messages.content: 想像你是一位雕塑家，正在進行一個大型項目的工作。你有兩種不同密度的材料可供使用。第一種材料的密度為5.2克/立方公分，第二種材料的密度為7.8克/立方公分。你計劃創建兩個相同的圓錐體，每個的底面半徑為10公分，高度為30公分。第一個圓錐體將使用第一種材料製作，第二個圓錐體將使用第二種材料製作。你能計算出圓錐體的體積（四捨五入到小數點後兩位），然後根據它們各自的密度計算出每個圓錐體的質量嗎？

function.name: geometry_calculate_cone_volume
function.description: Calculate the volume of a cone given the radius and height. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

radius.description: Radius of the cone base. This is a float type value.

height.description: Height of the cone. This is a float type value.

round_off.description: Number of decimal places to round off the answer.

function.name: physics_calculate_cone_mass
function.description: Calculate the mass of a cone given the radius, height, and density. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

radius.description: Radius of the cone base. This is a float type value.

height.description: Height of the cone. This is a float type value.

density.description: Density of the material the cone is made of. This is a float type value.

message.reasoning:
The user wants us to calculate the volume of a cone with radius=10 cm, height=30 cm, round to two decimal places. Then compute mass using densities 5.2 g/cm^3 and 7.8 g/cm^3 respectively.

We have a tool for calculating volume: geometry_calculate_cone_volume. We can call it with radius=10, height=30, round_off=2. That will return the volume. Then we need to compute mass: physics_calculate_cone_mass with radius=10, height=30, density=5.2 for first, and density=7.8 for second. The mass calculation uses the same formula: mass = density * volume. But the tool expects radius, height, density. It will compute mass accordingly. We should call physics_calculate_cone_mass twice with appropriate densities.

We need to output the results. The user didn't specify format but likely want the volume and masses. We'll provide them in a friendly manner.

We need to use the tool calls. We'll do one call to geometry_calculate_cone_volume. Then two calls to physics_calculate_cone_mass. We'll then combine results.
